HE WILL DO ANYTHING TO SAVE HIS FAMILY, AND THE CITY HE LOVES...

New York's greatest detective returns in the new thriller from Sunday Times bestselling author, James Patterson.

In New York City, someone has planted a series of deadly bombs.

In New Jersey, the National Guard is looted for explosives.

In Montana, arson and murder rocks a quiet town.

Two enigmatic brothers keep turning up in the wrong places.

They insist they’re trying to make the world a better place.

But with lives hanging in the balance, Detective Michael Bennett is called to investigate.

Can he solve the case before their delusions lead to a nationwide disaster?
